sentences.text: The gist of accusation against the petitioner is mainly with regard to preparation of final bill of the contract involved in the execution of PMGSY Package No. AS-13-261, pertaining to construction of "Anipur NUC road at Harinagar to PuboBaruala", along with construction of two numbers of RCC bridges, in which bills were passed in payment.
4. It is alleged in the FIR that the petitioner had released the final bill to the contractor without the works of the said project being completed.

5. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is an Assistant Executive Engineer, who is employed as a contractual employee and he was involved only in preparation of bridges and was not the authority to clear the bills.
He submits that in the meanwhile, an enquiry was conducted and the report of the Enquiry Officer shows that the work pertaining to the aforesaid project has already been completed.
6. He further submits that in the meanwhile, the petitioner had received notice under Section 41A of the CrPC and he had co-operated in the investigation.
7. He also submits that in a similar matter, a Co-ordinate bench of this Court has granted interim protection to one of the co-accused, Page No.# 3/4 namely, Md. Mohosin Ahmed Laskar.

The case is fixed for the perusal of the Case Diary on 10.11.2025.
8.
He submits that the police has visited his residence even after co-operating in the investigation and therefore, he is apprehensive that he may be arrested in this case.
9. On the other hand, the learned Additional Special Public Prosecutor submits that there is no apprehension of getting petitioner arrested.

10. He further submits that in the meanwhile, AB Case No. 2507/2025 is listed on 10.11.2025 and Case Diary has been called, along with another Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2562/2025.
11.
He submits that this case may also be listed, along with those cases as Case Diary has already been called for.

12. The prayer is allowed.
13. Let the Case Diary be called for.
14.
Let this case be listed, along with the aforesaid Anticipatory Bail Application on 10.11.2025.

15. In the meanwhile, if before arrival of the Case Diary, the petitioner is arrested in connection with the aforesaid case, he shall be allowed to go on interim bail of Rs. 30,000/- with a suitable surety of Sahidur Rahman Laskar vs The State Of Assam on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97915332/
2 like amount each, subject to the satisfaction of the arresting authority with following conditions that:-
Page No.# 4/4 (i) the petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Police Officer within 7(seven)
days from the date of this order and shall co-operate with the investigation; and (ii) the petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to the informant or to any other person who may be acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade such person from disclosing such facts before the Investigating Officer or to any Court.
16. List accordingly.
